In der Rolle des Online Marketing Managers (m/w/d) kalkulierst und steuerst du die Werbebudgets unserer Kunden. Ziel ist es die bestmögliche Sichtbarkeit mit einem vorgegebenen Budget zu erreichen. Um die Fortschritte der Arbeit auch dem Kunden zu übermitteln, werden regelmäßig Auswertungen erstellt. Auch die Positionierung der Produkte an gewünschten Werbeplätzen spielt hierbei eine große Rolle.🚀
Aufgaben
Entwicklung von SEA-Strategien : Gemeinsam mit unseren Account Managern arbeitest du zielgerichtete SEA-Strategien aus und sorgst dafür, dass das volle Werbepotenzial auf Amazon ausgeschöpft wird.
Keywordrecherche & Analyse : Du führst umfassende Keywordrecherchen durch und kümmerst dich um die On- und Offpage-Optimierung, um die Sichtbarkeit der Produkte zu maximieren.
Kampagnenoptimierung : Dein Ziel ist es, das Potenzial der Kampagnen optimal auszuschöpfen und kontinuierlich zu verbessern.
Datenbasierte Maßnahmen : Du erstellst Analysen und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen zur Weiterentwicklung der Kampagnen ab – mit Hilfe von Analyse-Tools behältst du den Erfolg stets im Blick.
Reporting : Du erstellst regelmäßige Reportings, um die Ergebnisse der Kampagnen transparent für unsere Kunden darzustellen.
Amazon Seller Central : Du bist versiert im Umgang mit dem Amazon Seller Central und nutzt es zur Steuerung der Werbekampagnen.
PPC-Preisoptimierung : Du optimierst die PPC-Preise basierend auf vorher festgelegten Strategien und sorgst dafür, dass das Budget optimal eingesetzt wird.
Qualifikation
Studium: Du bist immatrikulierte/r Student/in.
Selbstständiges Arbeiten : Du bist in der Lage, eigenständig zu arbeiten und eigenverantwortlich Projekte zu steuern.
Schnelle Auffassungsgabe : Du hast die Fähigkeit, dich schnell in neue Themengebiete einzuarbeiten und Lösungen zu finden.
Team- und Kommunikationsfähigkeit : Du arbeitest gerne im Team und bist kommunikationsstark – sowohl intern als auch im Austausch mit Kunden.
Analytisches Verständnis : Du liebst es, mit Zahlen zu arbeiten und hast ein gutes Verständnis für analytische Zusammenhänge.
Strukturierte Kommunikation : Du kommunizierst klar und strukturiert – egal ob schriftlich oder mündlich.
Excel- und PowerPoint : Du hast sehr gute Kenntnisse in Excel und PowerPoint und weißt, wie man diese Tools effektiv einsetzt, um Ergebnisse zu präsentieren und Daten auszuwerten.

Hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Kombination aus Home Office und Arbeit im Büro, für mehr Flexibilität und Teamgeist.
Weiterentwicklungs- und Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten: Zugang zu Schulungen und Workshops, um deine Fähigkeiten kontinuierlich auszubauen und deine Karriere innerhalb der Agentur voranzutreiben.
Teamkultur: Ein motiviertes, unterstützendes Team und eine offene Arbeitskultur.
Ausstattung: Moderne Arbeitsmittel und leistungsstarke Tools für deine täglichen Aufgaben.

This is a company built for growth, not comfort.
When you join exmox, you’re stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field - solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone.
We build high-performing consumer products across multiple brands in one of the most competitive industries there is: mobile gaming. You will be part of a company that is on a path of hyper-growth, spearheading one of the largest innovations in the mobile gaming industry - a rewarded user engagement and user acquisition platform. We help mobile game publishers not only acquire new users, but also keep players engaged through rewarding experiences.
At exmox, engagement isn't an afterthought - it's one of our most important growth levers. Our reward apps (Testerup, Empfohlen, Testerheld) reach hundreds of thousands of active users, and increasing retention and customer lifetime value remains a major opportunity.
As our first Senior CRM Manager (m/f/x) , you will build this function from the ground up. You'll define the strategy, select and implement the CRM platform, design lifecycle journeys, and establish a culture of experimentation and optimization. Working closely with Product, Data, Engineering, and User Acquisition, you'll transform user insights into personalized experiences that drive activation, retention, re-engagement, and long-term value.
If you're excited by building from zero, combining strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and owning a growth function with direct business impact, this role offers the autonomy, visibility, and ownership to make a difference from day one, we want to hear from you.

Own the CRM platform end-to-end, including selection, implementation, and integration of user data across Testerup, Empfohlen, and Testerheld.
Define and execute the CRM strategy and channel roadmap across push, in-app, and email, translating business goals into measurable lifecycle initiatives.
Design, launch, and optimize lifecycle journeys across onboarding, retention, reactivation, and long-term value growth.
Build behavioral segmentation, personalization, and experimentation frameworks to deliver the right message to the right user at the right time.
Own CRM performance metrics (activation, retention, reactivation, ARPU, and LTV), using A/B testing and user insights to drive continuous improvement.
Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data, and UA teams to ensure CRM is deeply integrated into the product experience and aligned with acquisition efforts.
Scale the CRM function from single-app engagement to cross-app lifecycle orchestration, leveraging advanced segmentation and predictive capabilities as the business grows.

Lifecycle journeys launch quickly: Onboarding, retention, and win-back programs are live within your first months, delivering personalized experiences across push, in-app, and email.
Retention and LTV measurably improve: Your lifecycle strategy drives meaningful gains in activation, retention, reactivation, ARPU, and LTV within your first two quarters.
CRM decisions are driven by data: Segmentation, experimentation, and performance reporting provide clear insights that guide lifecycle priorities and investment decisions.
Cross-functional teams are aligned around the user lifecycle: You partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data, and UA teams to create a seamless user journey and shared ownership of lifecycle KPIs.
You turn ambiguity into scalable systems: Through automation, testing, and process building, you establish CRM as a repeatable and scalable growth lever for the business.

Experienced: 5+ years of CRM experience, ideally within mobile apps, gaming, reward platforms, subscriptions, or app-first consumer businesses.
Expert: Hands-on experience implementing and managing CRM platforms, with expertise in audience segmentation, journey orchestration, personalization, and campaign automation. Experience with platforms such as Braze or OneSignal is a plus.
Data-Driven: Strong analytical mindset with experience measuring activation, retention, reactivation, ARPU, and LTV. Comfortable using data to identify opportunities, prioritize initiatives, and evaluate performance.
Experimentation-Focused: Proven track record designing and scaling lifecycle programs through A/B testing, user segmentation, and continuous optimization across push, in-app, and email channels.
Collaborative: Able to work effectively with Product, Engineering, Data, Design, and Marketing teams, translating user insights into impactful lifecycle strategies.
Work Approach: You thrive in an international, fast-paced environment and comfortable working with minimal direction in ambiguous situations.
What You Can Expect
Ambitious people, real ownership. You’ll work with driven, entrepreneurial people who care deeply about what they deliver, challenge each other openly, and own outcomes together.
We’re playing at the top, but we’re not done. Our apps rank in the top 5 of their categories. We’re determined to push further, compete harder, and earn the number one spot.
You own your own growth. Growth doesn’t happen by accident. At exmox, learning is built into the work - through responsibility, feedback, and real challenges.
Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great - but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the people, and the drive to win together.
Please note: this is not a remote only position, we offer you a flexible hybrid model here in Hamburg, Germany - working from home on Mondays & Fridays, coming to the office on Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday!

ID Sports is the headquarters behind the GIBBON brand in Europe. Since 2008, GIBBON has been one of the defining brands in the field of balance training. From Stuttgart, we steer international growth, further develop the brand, and drive our marketing and sales activities forward through digital channels.

With the introduction of the SlackBoard, we are unlocking additional growth potential and further expanding brand awareness in relevant markets. Our products stand for balance, movement, and innovation, combining performance, health, and lifestyle.

We are seeking a highly motivated and results-driven Performance Marketing Manager to lead and scale our paid acquisition strategy across the EMEA markets. This role will be exclusively responsible for managing paid social, paid search and shopping, and programmatic advertising campaigns to drive sustainable Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) revenue growth, customer acquisition, and efficiency.
The ideal candidate blends data-driven analytical expertise with a hands-on mentality to optimize the digital conversion funnel. You will sit at the intersection of growth marketing and commercial execution, continuously testing and scaling digital channels to capture market share.
The Performance Marketing Manager reports to the Director of Growth Marketing and is based out of our Stuttgart, Germany headquarters.
Aufgaben
Leadership & Ownership
Own the day-to-day execution, performance, and strategy of paid social, paid search & shopping, and programmatic ad channels across Europe, Middle East and Asia.
Take full accountability for targets and Core KPIs, including ROAS, CAC, MER, and profitability.
Manage the paid media budget efficiently, ensuring optimal allocation across platforms and markets.
Ensure a clear and consistent brand identity across all digital marketing consumer touchpoints.
Strategy & Growth
Develop, steer, and execute scalable growth campaigns with a clear focus on DTC performance.
Build out targeting and structure media buying frameworks to scale international market share.
Design, implement, and maintain rigorous testing roadmaps to drive continuous account efficiency.
Understand the full B2C conversion funnel and optimize user paths from discovery to purchase.
Execution & Optimization
Ensure flawless campaign setup, tracking configuration, and ongoing optimization across ad platforms.
Actively participate with creative resources to brief, test, and iterate high-performing ad creatives.
Monitor, analyze, and report on channel health metrics, translating insights into clear growth levers.
Coordinate with external agencies, freelancers, and vendors to maximize campaign output and efficiency.
Cross-Functional Leadership
Collaborate closely with the eCommerce team to align ad spend with site features and enhancements.
Partner with international teams regarding markets, commercial goals, and global priority alignments.
Collaborate with the Operations team to align demand forecasting with market inventory levels.
Qualifikation
4+ years of hands-on experience managing paid acquisition channels for a high-growth DTC brand.
Proven track record of managing scalable growth budgets with a focus on efficiency and profitability.
Deep expertise across the Meta Ads, Google Ads ecosystem, and modern programmatic platforms.
Strong analytical thinking and understanding of e-commerce unit economics, CAC, ROAS, and MER.
Hands-on mentality: prioritizing, testing, and implementing with an execution focus under uncertainty.
Excellent written and spoken English; proficiency in German or other European languages is preferred.
Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Analytics, or a related field preferred.
Ability to work out of the Stuttgart, Germany office is preferred.

A key role with high responsibility and immediate impact on a growing international brand.
The opportunity to shape a pragmatic, performance-oriented, and entrepreneurial growth culture.
Competitive salary and regional benefits aligned with your job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.
Please submit resumes in English.

Trends & Innovation: Du hast ein Auge auf neue Werbeformen und bringst eigene Ideen direkt auf die Straße.
Qualifikation

Keine Angst vor Zahlen: Du kannst Ergebnisse datengetrieben interpretieren und die richtigen Schlussfolgerungen daraus ziehen.

Das richtige Allrounder-Mindset: Du bist neugierig, denkst lösungsorientiert und hast Lust, dich flexibel in neue Marketing-Disziplinen einzuarbeiten.

Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Gestalte deinen Arbeitstag so, wie er zu deinem Leben passt – dank Vertrauensarbeitszeit und Gleitzeit.

About Wolt
At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.
Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.
As the Senior Global Integrated B2B Marketing Manager , you will own the end-to-end marketing direction for one of Wolt's most strategic B2B business units. You will act as the marketing lead for Wolt for Work or Commerce Platform, responsible for turning business goals into clear priorities, strong narratives, and focused go-to-market execution across markets.
What you'll be doing
This role is about direction, judgment, and orchestration. You will work with specialized B2B marketing functions such as product marketing, content, paid, lifecycle, events, creative, brand, and PR, who own craft and execution. Your job is to make sense of it all, ask the hard questions, challenge assumptions, and ensure everything ladders up to one cohesive strategy that drives growth.
You will operate as a senior, trusted partner to product and commercial leaders, leading through influence rather than people management, and acting as a force multiplier for the entire marketing organization.

Own the global integrated marketing strategy and initiative roadmap for Wolt for Work, aligned with business, product, sales, and regional priorities
Act as the main marketing lead for the Wolt for Work business unit, partnering closely with global and local product and commercial stakeholders
Translate business goals into clear, focused 360-degree marketing plans across the funnel
Bring together product marketing, content, paid, lifecycle, events, brand, creative, and PR into cohesive GTM programs, while functions own execution
Own selected global and market-level initiatives end-to-end, from problem definition to delivery and impact measurement
Define priorities and make clear tradeoffs to ensure focus on the highest-impact opportunities
Shape the Wolt for Work narrative in the market, including brand positioning, key messages, and external storytelling
Define and track success metrics across awareness, adoption, and revenue, turning performance into clear insights and recommendations
Manage allocated campaign budgets with accountability for impact and ROI
Identify gaps, missed opportunities, and risks early, and actively push for better focus, quality, and outcomes
Drive alignment and momentum across teams and senior stakeholders without direct authority
Our humble expectations
Proven experience owning integrated B2B marketing in a complex, fast-moving, or multi-market environment
Strong cross-functional marketing background, with hands-on understanding of demand generation, product marketing, lifecycle, content, and brand, even if you did not specialize in all of them
Strategic and commercial mindset, comfortable owning direction, prioritization, and outcomes
Confidence to challenge, ask tough questions, and push for clarity while remaining collaborative and constructive
Ability to create structure and focus in ambiguous or loosely defined situations
Demonstrated ability to lead through influence and build trust with senior stakeholders
Strong analytical skills, including defining KPIs and using data to guide decisions
Clear, confident communicator who can align teams around a shared direction
Fluent (C2-level) in English and German is a plus
Experience in SaaS, platforms, or multi-product B2B businesses is a strong plus

The opportunity to build something meaningful and global, surrounded by kind and ambitious people.
A chance to shape how Wolt's B2B products reach and impact businesses across markets.
Lots of learning, growth, and ownership in a high-growth tech environment.
Competitive salary and benefits, including eligibility for our long-term incentive plan.
A genuinely supportive culture that values diversity, curiosity, and getting better every day.

Introduction
Du willst nicht einfach Kampagnen abarbeiten sondern Marketing von Grund auf aufbauen? Du denkst in Systemen, hast ein Gespür für Zahlen und weißt gleichzeitig, wie man Botschaften formuliert, die ankommen?
Wir sind Omnora, eine B2B SaaS-Company aus Frankfurt. Wir helfen Unternehmen wie DB, AOK und ADAC dabei, ihr Wissen zu sichern, zu strukturieren und nutzbar zu machen - mit KI.
Als unser Marketing Manager bist du von Tag 1 an die treibende Kraft hinter unserem gesamten Marketing. Du steuerst Kampagnen über alle Kanäle hinweg, baust unsere Performance-Marketing-Infrastruktur auf und entwickelst Schritt für Schritt eine Struktur, aus der langfristig eine echte Marketingabteilung entsteht. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit dem Management Team zusammen - ohne festgefahrene Prozesse, dafür mit echter Gestaltungsfreiheit.
Kurz gesagt: Du bist unser Founding Marketing Manager. Was du hier aufbaust, gehört dir.
What's in it for me
Founding-Role mit echter Ownership: Du baust nicht in einer Abteilung mit - du baust die Abteilung. Was du hier aufbaust, trägt langfristig deinen Fingerabdruck und bietet dir echte Entwicklungsperspektive in Richtung Marketing Lead.
Blitzschnelles Lernen: Du tauchst in alle Disziplinen ein - von Content über Performance bis Automation - und lernst in Monaten, wofür andere Jahre brauchen.
Gestaltungsfreiraum: Statt festgefahrener Prozesse erwartet dich maximaler Freiraum, Dinge auszuprobieren.
Kurze Wege, großer Einfluss: Du arbeitest eng mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen und siehst, wie deine Arbeit das Unternehmen bewegt.
Hybrides Arbeiten: Was zählt, ist dein Beitrag - nicht wo du sitzt. Wir arbeiten hybrid aus Frankfurt mit flexiblen Home-Office-Möglichkeiten.
Der perfekte Einstiegszeitpunkt: Mit marktreifem Produkt und starken Referenzen stehen wir vor dem nächsten Wachstumsschritt - der ideale Moment, um einzusteigen und mitzugestalten.
How you can make an impact
Performance Marketing & Lead Generation: Du planst, steuerst und optimierst Kampagnen auf Google Ads und LinkedIn mit einem klaren Ziel: qualifizierte Leads für unser Sales-Team. CPL, ROAS und Pipeline-Contribution sind deine Währung - nicht nice-to-haves, sondern tägliche Steuerungsgrößen.
Account-Based Marketing: Du entwickelst ABM-Kampagnen, die gezielt Enterprise-Accounts in der DACH-Region ansprechen - mit den richtigen Botschaften, zur richtigen Zeit, auf den richtigen Kanälen.
Omni-Channel Orchestrierung: Du steuerst alle Marketingkanäle zusammen - Paid, Organic, Content, Email - und sorgst dafür, dass sie als System funktionieren statt als Einzelmaßnahmen nebeneinander zu laufen.
Content & Kreation: Du entwickelst Formate und Inhalte, die bei unseren Zielgruppen ankommen, und testest kontinuierlich, was wirklich performt - datenbasiert statt Bauchgefühl.
Marketing-Infrastruktur: Du baust eine skalierbare Infrastruktur auf - von HubSpot-Automation über Lead-Tracking bis hin zu verlässlichem Reporting.
KI & Automatisierung: Du nutzt aktiv KI-Tools, um Prozesse zu automatisieren - von der Content-Produktion bis hin zu personalisierten Kampagnen.
Agentur-Steuerung: Du bist zentraler Ansprechpartner für unsere Marketing-Agentur, briefst Kampagnen, gibst Feedback und stellst sicher, dass Ergebnisse geliefert werden.
Sales-Marketing-Alignment: Du bist die aktive Schnittstelle zum Vertrieb und stellst sicher, dass Leads nicht nur generiert, sondern auch konvertiert werden.
Skills to be successful
Erste echte Berufserfahrung: Du bringst 1-3 Jahre Erfahrung im Marketing mit - idealerweise im B2B SaaS-, Tech- oder Startup-Umfeld. Du hast Kampagnen nicht nur betreut, sondern eigenverantwortlich gesteuert und bist damit auch mal auf die Nase gefallen. Beides ist wertvoll.
Akademischer Hintergrund: Abschluss einer Top-Universität oder mit überdurchschnittlichen Noten in Marketing, BWL, Kommunikation o. ä.
Performance-Marketing-Kompetenz: Du kennst dich mit Paid Media auf Google und LinkedIn aus, weißt wie man Kampagnen aufsetzt, optimiert und bewertet. Längere Sales-Cycles und komplexe Buying Center sind dir nicht fremd.
Zahlenaffinität: Bei uns wird alles gemessen und getrackt. Du scheust dich nicht vor Dashboards und KPIs, sondern nutzt sie als Kompass für deine tägliche Arbeit. Zahlen sind für dich die Basis jeder Entscheidung, nicht lästige Pflicht.
HubSpot & Automation: Erfahrung mit HubSpot Marketing Hub - idealerweise inkl. Segmentierung, Automation und Attribution - ist ein klares Plus.
KI-Affinität: Du hast Berührungspunkte mit KI-gestützten Tools in der Content-Produktion oder Lead-Generierung und bist neugierig, das weiterzuentwickeln.
Kreatives Auge: Du hast ein Gespür für Sprache und Design - für LinkedIn-Posts genauso wie für Kampagnen-Creatives. Erfahrung mit Canva oder Adobe Creative Cloud ist ein Plus.
Extreme Ownership: Du brauchst niemanden, der dir sagt was zu tun ist. Wenn du eine Chance siehst, ergreifst du sie. Wenn Hindernisse kommen, überspringst du sie. Du gehst voran.
Kommunikation & Kollaboration: Du kommunizierst klar und präzise - intern wie extern, auf Deutsch und Englisch.

About Nivoda
Nivoda is a fast-growing B2B marketplace that is transforming the global diamond and gemstone industry. We connect buyers and sellers across the world, processing $300M+ in annual transactions and unlocking a $350B industry opportunity. We move fast, think big, and care deeply about the businesses and people we serve.

The diamond trading industry has historically been fragmented, opaque, and inaccessible. Nivoda was founded to change that: to empower businesses of all sizes and locations to participate in a fair, efficient global marketplace. Every line of code, every integration, every automation we build brings us closer to that mission.

We are looking for a Product Marketing Lead to own how Nivoda explains itself: the positioning, the messaging, and the story that makes independent jewellers understand why we are worth switching to. This is the foundation the rest of marketing is built on, from paid campaigns to sales conversations. You will define who we are for, what we say, and why it lands, and then arm the whole go-to-market team to say it consistently.
This is a hands-on role. You will own positioning and messaging, lead the go-to-market for new product launches, sharpen our competitive edge, and build the sales enablement that turns interest into customers.
You will start as a senior individual contributor with real ownership of product marketing end to end. As the company grows there is room to build a function beneath you, but this is a role for a builder who wants to do the work, not just direct it.
What would YOU be doing?
Own Nivoda’s positioning and messaging: define who we are for, the problems we solve, and the words we use, and keep them sharp as the business evolves.
Lead the go-to-market for product launches. Shape the narrative, coordinate across teams, and make sure new features land with the jewellers they are built for.
Build the competitive intelligence that keeps us ahead: understand the alternatives jewellers weigh, and give the team the arguments that win.
Arm our sales team with the enablement they need, from one-pagers and decks to talk tracks, so every conversation tells a consistent and compelling story.
Own the messaging and narrative on our core product and positioning pages, partnering with the teams who own the website and the signup experience.
Shape our pricing and packaging story so the value is obvious and easy to say yes to.
Feed clear, tested messaging into demand gen and content, so campaigns ladder up to one coherent point of view without ever feeling like an ad.
Ground everything in customer truth: talk to jewellers, run win/loss, and turn what you learn into sharper positioning.
Partner closely with product and the growth PM so what we build and how we talk about it stay in lockstep.
What do we need from YOU?
5+ years in product marketing, ideally at a B2B or marketplace company, with a track record of positioning and launches that moved the business.
You are a builder. You would rather write the messaging, run the launch, and ship the deck than hand it off.
Exceptional writing and storytelling. You can take something complex and make it simple, sharp, and persuasive.
A strategic head for positioning: you can define a market, a segment, and a wedge, and defend your choices.
Comfort with data and customer research. You start from evidence, not opinion.
You work well across functions, especially with sales and product, and you build trust quickly.
Comfort as a senior IC on a small team, building process where none exists, with the ambition to grow a function over time.
You are AI forward, always testing new tools, and learnings new applications of AI to improve your efficiency and effectiveness

We're on a mission
Every business grows through a CRM and a direct line to its customers. Healthcare, and pharmacy most of all, is the one place that never happened. It was too hard to build, too hard to distribute, and too hard to do compliantly. Customer data sits idle whilst running a community healthcare business continues to become structurally tighter.
We're on a mission to change that. We are the compliant data layer for community healthcare: the system that lets a pharmacy use the patient data it already holds to grow revenue and relationships, compliantly, on the clinical system it already runs.
This is already working. Pharmlogic is NHS-assured, integrated and lives in hundreds of pharmacies nationwide, and we've powered millions of patient communications.

You will run marketing across the board: brand and social, the website, copy across everything we put out, how we explain the product, and the campaigns that keep our pharmacy customers engaged. You own the channels and you set the standard for how Pharmlogic sounds and looks.
You report to the CEO and work closely with the founding team. This is a hands-on role for a generalist who can write, ship, and run several channels at once without waiting to be told. You are early, and the function is yours to shape.
The problems you'll own
Carrying the message: Take our vision, the why behind Pharmlogic, and make it land with the people we exist for. You translate what we believe into words that busy healthcare teams trust and can act on.
Communicating in a regulated space: Everything we put out can be read by healthcare professionals, other stakeholders and by patients. You write with the clarity, accuracy and care that demands, where compliant and compelling are the same standard, not a trade-off.
Our voice, everywhere: Own how Pharmlogic sounds across social, the website, campaigns and the product itself. One voice, centred on the vision, consistent wherever someone meets us.
From product to message: Turn what we build into messaging tailored to all stakeholders in a busy healthcare team that can be immediately understood. You make the complex simple without sacrificing value.
The customer journey: Own the communications that take a pharmacy from signed to thriving, engaged, getting full value, and staying, so the story we tell is the experience they have.
Knowing what works: Measure what you put out, double down on what performs, and feed what you learn back into how we market, sell and build.
Pharmlogic in the room: with the team at sector events, from the stand and the materials to the follow-up, so the people we meet in person get the same clear story as everyone else, and conversations turn into pipeline.
This could be for you if
You're an excellent communicator, above all. Writing is the craft at the centre of this job. You make complex things simple without making them shallow, you have taste, and it shows in everything you put out.
You've done lifecycle and product marketing in high-pace SaaS. You know how to take what a product does and turn it into a message people act on, and how to run the journey from signed customer to engaged advocate. That experience is what lets you move fast here from day one.
You thrive on the team's success. You get more from a customer win or a teammate's great launch than from your own byline. Small team, shared scoreboard.
You share the vision. You believe every healthcare business should be able to understand its customers and improve care for them while staying viable. If that sentence resonates rather than reads as marketing, this will feel like your work, not just a job.
You ship at startup pace. You put things out, learn, and go again, rather than polishing one thing for a month, and you do it without waiting for a brief.
Tooling fluency helps. Comfort with a CMS, email platforms, CRMs and basic design is a real advantage.
What you'll get
You'll be joining a fast-growing company and a small, sharp team focused on making community healthcare thrive.

Why will you love this job?
Architect a Scaling Engine: You will help evolve Testlio from a managed services-led testing business into a scalable, technology-enabled Quality Intelligence platform with a clearer category narrative, stronger product marketing, and a more predictable enterprise demand engine that is powered by modern data, automation, and AI-assisted ways of working.

Why will you love being a part of Testlio?
Great Culture: Testlio is a female-founded company, and half of our team identifies as women. We’re proud of our inclusive, purpose-driven culture where people genuinely enjoy collaborating. As part of our team (we call ourselves TestLions), you’ll help create exceptional digital experiences for our customers, while also contributing to our freelance network.
Remote Work: Our culture is built around remote work. We’ve created systems to allow us to successfully work together asynchronously as a fully remote and globally distributed team. Testlio provides the tools and guidance for everyone to succeed in their careers in a fully remote setting. Our working style encourages everyone to make decisions, communicate effectively, and work at a sustainable pace.
Investment in You: Your growth and well-being matter to us. You’ll have flexible paid time off—including national holidays, personal days, and sick days—plus stock options so you can grow with Testlio. We also provide a $300 annual learning stipend to support your personal and professional development.
Winning Business: Testlio is growing, profitable, and cash-strong. We are leading our industry with exceptional clients who provide us with a high NPS score and a 4.7 rating on G2. Our business model is global, enterprise, and subscription-based. Many of our larger clients have been with us for 7+ years, and spend >$500K ARR with Testlio.
What will you own?
Go-to-Market Strategy: Define and lead the global marketing strategy across brand, demand generation, product marketing, customer marketing, partner marketing, and marketing operations.
Demand Generation & Scale: Design and scale a data-driven demand generation engine, utilizing advanced account-based marketing (ABM),multi-channel orchestration, intent data, predictive insights, and intelligent personalization to build predictable pipeline for our sales enterprise teams.
Product Marketing & Positioning: Lead product marketing to clearly communicate our technical value proposition and the capabilities of the LeoAI Engine™ to CTOs, VPs of Engineering, and QA leaders.
Brand & Category Leadership: Build global brand awareness and establish Testlio as the absolute authority in crowdsourced software testing and automated pipeline solutions amidst a competitive landscape.
Team Orchestration & Mentorship: Hire, mentor, and structurally scale a high-performing global marketing team, instilling a culture of metric accountability, AI-enabled productivity, and operational continuous improvement.
Sales Alignment & Revenue Operations: Partner with sales and revenue operations to implement seamless tracking, lead scoring, and optimized attribution structures across all acquisition channels.
Executive & Financial Reporting: Own the global marketing budget, ensure capital-efficient resource allocation, and deliver data-backed growth forecasts directly to the executive board.
What do you need to succeed?
Technical Skills
10+ years of progressive marketing experience within B2B SaaS, DevOps, or technical software ecosystems, including executive management roles.
Proven track record of scaling an investor-backed, B2B software organization past $40M ARR up to $100M+ ARR.
Masterful understanding of enterprise pipeline mechanics, account-based marketing frameworks, and sales-marketing conversion funnels.
Direct experience orchestrating advanced martech stacks, attribution software, intent data platforms, and AI-enabled tools that improve segmentation, personalization, content production, campaign optimization, and revenue visibility. (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, 6sense, or Bombora).
Proven ability to embed AI into marketing workflows to improve content velocity, campaign experimentation, customer insight generation, audience segmentation, personalization, reporting, and team productivity.
Practical knowledge of software delivery models, continuous integration pipelines (CI/CD), or modern software testing landscapes.
Deep expertise managing million-dollar budgets, projecting customer lifetime value (LTV), and minimizing customer acquisition costs (CAC).
Human Skills
Strategic Visionary: You easily connect high-level commercial strategies to exact, actionable team campaigns without losing sight of corporate revenue metrics.
Radical Collaboration: You build trust cross-functionally and partner with sales, product, and delivery units to elevate the company's shared market path.
Data-Fluent Communicator: You translate technical outputs and marketing analytics into highly impactful stories for boards, clients, and partners.
Adaptable Scale Driver: You possess the agility to guide team priorities forward through rapid corporate transitions, evolving market conditions, and the changing role of AI in how modern marketing teams operate..
Growth & Mentorship Mindset: You focus heavily on elevating corporate capabilities, sharing actionable insights, and fostering internal marketing talent.
What is the application process?
At Testlio, we aim to hire individuals who are excited about their role, thrive in a fully remote environment, and have strong long-term potential with our team. Because we are a fully distributed company, our interview process includes conversations with several team members so you can get a well-rounded understanding of the role, the people you’ll work with, and how we collaborate. As a result, our interview process typically takes 3–4 weeks to complete.

Product Marketing Manager- Remote
3M Health Care is now Solventum

At Solventum , we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum , we never stop solving for you.
The Impact You’ll Make in this Role
Solventum Health Information Systems (HIS) is the world leader in building healthcare payment, patient safety and quality methodologies. Solventum payment and quality solutions have been adopted in over 12 countries as the basis hospital payment, facility payment and for quality measurement.

Solventum HIS also works with thousands of health systems, hundreds of health plans, regional governments, researchers, consultants to advance innovative models of value based care, accountable care, and payment innovation that promote population health and cost efficiency.

The Product Marketing Manager for the United States will be accountable for strategic marketing plans creation and execution of the Solventum health care payment innovation, population health, and quality methodologies portfolio.

This role will design and implement key messaging and core content, value propositions, and other key product marketing, promotion mix, and activation tactics as needed. This role will collaborate with business unit stakeholders to ensure the marketing plans support strategic vision and divisional financial objectives.
Driving market awareness and adoption for Solventum proprietary and public methodologies as well as internal and external awareness for methodologies’ value proposition in Solventum software and services offerings across the division
Owning new product introduction marketing deliverables through gate review process as needed for new methodologies.
Conducting customer insights, competitive and market research to develop a comprehensive and division wide holistic marketing plan for existing product portfolio and for new product commercialization.
Leading the strategy and execution of marketing deliverables for implementation of government and payer adopted methodology events as applicable.
Managing the execution, reporting, follow-up and adjustment of marketing plan tactics such as development of core content for assigned solutions (e.g. landing pages, case studies, fact sheets, eGuides, etc.)
Developing the strategy and executing key marketing/promotion mix activation tactics in concert with marketing support teams such as events, webinars, and advertising for methodologies portfolio.
Working closely with business unit managers and sales teams (grouper applications, regulatory and payer solutions, clinical and economic research, and related provider teams) to support strategic growth programs.

Bachelor’s Degree or higher from (completed and verified prior to start) an accredited institution AND ten (10) years of experience in product marketing.
Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:
Strongly preferred: At least five (5) years of experience using and/or marketing health care payment classification, population health, and/or quality methodologies

Master’s degree in marketing, Business Administration or Healthcare Management

Experience in development of thought leadership and industry influencers
Digital marketing savvy gained through experience
Key characteristics include self-starter, strategic thinker, creative, assertive, collaborative, action-oriented, clear writing and messaging ability, fast learner, strong business acumen, outstanding influencing skills and excellent presentation skills.

Title - PR & Marketing Executive
Location - Remote first but available for in person collaboration in Edinburgh or London
Aveni is redefining how financial institutions use AI. We build real, production-ready AI solutions that help financial services firms transform how they operate, manage risk and deliver better outcomes for their customers.
We’re looking for a PR & Marketing Executive to help build Aveni’s profile across the UK financial services market and support the delivery of our PR, communications and wider marketing activity.
This is a varied, hands-on role for someone who knows what makes a good story, enjoys building relationships with journalists and wants to develop their career at the intersection of AI, fintech and financial services.

Working closely with the Head of PR & Communications, you’ll help tell Aveni’s story to the market, building relationships with journalists and industry influencers, identifying opportunities for Aveni to contribute to the conversation and securing relevant media coverage.
You’ll support the development of proactive PR campaigns, commentary and thought leadership around Aveni’s business priorities, product developments, customer successes and the wider issues shaping financial services.
The role goes beyond traditional media relations. You’ll also contribute to customer stories, executive and internal communications, events, awards, speaker opportunities, analyst relations and wider marketing campaigns.
You’ll work across Aveni, collaborating with Marketing, Sales, Product, Customer Success and senior leadership to make sure our communications are timely, consistent and aligned with our brand and market positioning.
What you’ll be doing
You’ll build and maintain relationships with journalists across UK business, financial services, fintech, compliance, risk and technology media, proactively pitching stories, commentary, interviews and contributed content.
You’ll support the development and delivery of PR campaigns around Aveni’s business priorities, product launches, research, customer stories and relevant market developments.
You’ll help run Aveni’s day-to-day press office, responding to journalist enquiries, identifying commentary opportunities, coordinating interviews and preparing briefing materials.
You’ll maintain our communications and editorial calendar across PR, thought leadership, research, webinars, awards, speaking opportunities and company announcements.
You’ll work with Sales and Customer Success to identify and develop compelling customer stories, case studies, testimonials and joint communications.
You’ll support internal communications, helping colleagues stay informed about company news, customer wins, product developments, events and media coverage.
You’ll work with Aveni’s senior leaders and subject matter experts to build their external profiles through LinkedIn content, commentary, talking points and other communications.
You’ll support our thought leadership programme, helping develop webinars, research reports, whitepapers and other content around the issues that matter to our market.
You’ll identify and coordinate relevant conference, panel, podcast and webinar speaking opportunities, as well as industry awards.
You’ll support our relationships with industry analysts and research organisations and help coordinate analyst briefings and materials.
You’ll work with the wider Marketing team to support conferences, roundtables, webinars and customer events.

You’ll have solid experience in PR, communications or a closely related role, with experience working in a B2B environment.
You’ll have experience dealing directly with journalists and proactively pitching stories and ideas.
You’ll be a strong writer and editor, comfortable producing press releases, pitches, commentary and other external communications.
You’ll have strong news judgement and be able to identify what makes a compelling story and how to tailor it for different audiences.
You’ll be confident communicating with journalists, senior stakeholders and external partners.
You’ll be able to take complex or technical subjects and turn them into clear, engaging communications.
You’ll be highly organised, with excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines and priorities at the same time.
You’ll understand the role PR and communications play in building brand awareness, reputation and supporting wider commercial objectives.
You’ll have a genuine interest in AI, fintech, financial services and the wider media agenda.
You’ll be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities can change quickly and be confident building relationships across the business.

Experience working with UK financial services, fintech, compliance, risk, regulatory or technology media.
Experience within a PR agency and/or an in-house B2B communications role.
Existing relationships with journalists covering financial services, fintech, compliance, risk or related sectors.
Experience supporting events, awards, speaker programmes or analyst relations.
Familiarity with PR monitoring and media database platforms.
Experience using HubSpot or other marketing automation platforms.
An understanding of the UK financial services and regulatory environment, including areas such as Consumer Duty, compliance, conduct risk and AI governance.

You’ll be joining Aveni at an exciting point in our growth, working at the intersection of AI, regulation and financial services.
You’ll have the opportunity to help shape how Aveni shows up in the market, working directly with senior leaders, subject matter experts, customers and journalists to tell stories about some of the most important changes happening across financial services.
It’s a broad role with the opportunity to build experience across media relations, thought leadership, executive communications, customer advocacy and wider marketing – while having genuine ownership and visibility across the business.

Remote-first across the UK, with regular off-sites and in-person gatherings.
Work abroad policy.
Co-working spaces available.

Company-wide off-sites.
Optional Personal Development Plan.

Life Insurance, Income Protection and Critical Illness cover.
Pension with up to 5% matched employer contribution, with the option to increase contributions.
Private health and dental care.
Enhanced family leave.

Even if you don’t meet 100% of the requirements, we’d still like to hear from you if you believe you’d be a great fit.
Apply now to join us on our mission to transform the financial services industry through AI.

Product Marketing turns Chainalysis innovation into customer value. We position our intelligence as solutions customers can understand and consume through our platform, shape how we commercialize them, and give GTM the stories and strategic assets to win.
Financial services is a priority growth segment for Chainalysis, including banks, payments companies, fintechs, and other financial institutions. As digital assets become more connected to the financial system, these organizations face new opportunities, regulatory obligations, and financial-crime risks. This role makes the value of Chainalysis clear to the leaders responsible for navigating them.
As Senior Product Marketing Manager for Financial Services, you will own how Chainalysis shows up in the market for these buyers. You will own and shape our intelligence, data, products, AI capabilities, and services into a differentiated customer story—one that connects to real workflows, urgent problems, and business outcomes.
This is a role for a strong marketer and an exceptional writer. You can take a complex capability, a shifting market, or a fuzzy customer problem and shape it into a sharp point of view, a persuasive narrative, and practical tools that sellers and customers actually use. You will work closely with Product, Sales, Marketing & Communications, subject-matter experts, and GTM Solutions & Readiness teams to make the story land in the market.
What you’ll be doing
Position the value
Define and evolve the financial services value narrative: what Chainalysis enables, why it matters, and why we are meaningfully different.
Build messaging for priority buyer and user personas across compliance, risk, anti-fraud, investigations, and business leadership.
Create the narratives, proof points, and strategic assets that help sellers communicate differentiated value with conviction.
Own financial-services competitive intelligence, translating market moves into clear offensive and defensive positioning for deal teams.
Turn value into solutions
Partner with Product, R&D, Marketing & Communications, and subject-matter experts to translate innovation into compelling industry solutions, use cases, and sales plays.
Lead go-to-market planning for launches, major releases, platform capabilities, and commercial offerings.
Shape customer-facing value narratives for pricing, packaging, and commercial models, including business cases and ROI stories.
Bring a customer lens to product and market decisions: explain not only what a capability does, but why a Chief Compliance Officer or Head of Financial Crime should care.
Win and learn in market
Produce the strategic content that moves financial-services opportunities forward: first-call decks, solution briefs, talk tracks, discovery frameworks, proof points, and sales plays.
Partner with GTM Solutions & Readiness to scale the strongest narratives into field tools and enablement.
Bring customer, field, partner, and competitive insight back into the work — sharpening positioning, converting market evidence into credible stories, and building repeatable use cases.

5–8 years in product, solutions, industry, or B2B enterprise technology marketing, with experience in financial services, fintech, payments, or related regulated industry.
A demonstrated ability to build positioning and messaging that changes how customers and sellers see a problem—not simply content that fills a library.
Exceptional writing and editorial judgment. You can write crisp headlines, persuasive narratives, practical sales content, and executive-level messaging; you know the difference between jargon and precision.
Strong understanding of enterprise buying journeys and sales motions in regulated, risk-sensitive environments.
The ability to connect technical capabilities to business and operational value for both executive buyers and hands-on users.
A collaborative self-starter, comfortable working across R&D, Sales, technical and revenue teams, and senior leaders to drive ambiguous, multi-stakeholder work forward independently.

Experience with blockchain, digital assets, or crypto-native financial infrastructure.
Experience marketing AI-powered products, data platforms, intelligence products, cybersecurity, or risk and compliance technology.
Familiarity with consumption- or usage-based pricing and packaging.
Experience marketing to financial institutions at a data, intelligence, security, or enterprise-software company.

You can shape complexity into a story people remember and a sales conversation people can use. You write with precision, bring sound judgment to ambiguous problems, build for repeatability rather than one-off requests, and care about the quality of what reaches customers and the field.
AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality.

As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.
AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.
About Chainalysis
Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.
You belong here.
At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.
We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here . We can’t wait to meet you.

Accurx is solving healthcare productivity for the NHS
For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that slow everything down and leave patients waiting. At Accurx, we're changing that – building a platform used by 98% of GP practices and 68% of NHS Trusts to help every patient get gold-standard, efficient and joined-up care.
Accurx is transforming how NHS staff triage and prioritise patient demand, cut the admin that eats into clinical time, and works as one team across the system. With Accurx Scribe, our AI-powered note-taker, we're now changing the consultation itself – drafting notes in real-time so clinicians can give every patient their full attention.
We've spent eight years proving care doesn't always need to happen in an appointment. In the best triage practices today, 40% of patient demand is resolved without one. Now we're taking that model system-wide – using AI to automate the work that slows healthcare down, connecting every part of the NHS and building the platform on which the future of healthcare work gets done.

We're looking for a Senior Product Marketing Lead to own Accurx's narrative as we enter our most ambitious chapter yet. You'll define how our value lands across the NHS, lead creative launch and adoption campaigns and build the product marketing function that keeps pace with what we're shipping.
The challenges you'll take on
Set the direction for the function. Define the strategy for product marketing and sales enablement as Accurx becomes an AI-native company – identifying the highest-impact work, introducing AI workflows that change how the team operates and raising the bar across everything we put out.
Turn market insight into decisions. Make structured time with users, customers and competitors part of how the team works. Synthesise what you learn into positioning and messaging decisions that keep Accurx sharp in a fast-moving market.
Own the narrative. Ensure Accurx's story is consistent, compelling and evidence-based across our products, audiences and channels. Your team of two leads on individual products – your job is to make sure it all holds together.
Rethink how we go to market. As we ship faster than ever, a big part of this role is building the processes that let the team keep pace and finding creative ways to drive awareness and engagement.
Give commercial teams what they need to win. Work with the Sales Enablement Manager to set the bar for how Accurx shows up in commercial conversations – ensuring teams have the right messaging, evidence and market knowledge to win at every stage.
You should apply if...
You've led on AI-native product marketing. You've redesigned how a PMM function operates using AI – not just adopted tools, but rethought workflows from the ground up.
You write with clarity and precision. You have exceptional judgment for what great content looks like and hold your team to the same standard.
You've done both sides of the job. Product marketing to users and sales enablement for commercial teams. You know what each requires and how to run them as one function.
You've managed people well. You give clear direction, honest feedback and create space for people to do their best work.
You care about impact, not activity. You define success before you start, build in measurement and use data to improve.
You've thrived in SaaS or high-growth. You know how to operate at pace with ambiguity and commercial pressure.

Du adaptierst erfolgreiche internationale Inhalte für Deutschland – nicht als reine Übersetzung, sondern passend zu Markt, Zielgruppe und kulturellem Kontext.
Product & Sales Content
Du arbeitest eng mit Product Marketing, Product und Sales zusammen und entwickelst Content rund um Produktneuheiten, Launches und relevante Marktthemen .
Du machst aus komplexen Produkt-, regulatorischen und buchhalterischen Themen Inhalte, die einfach zu verstehen und gerne zu lesen sind.
Du entwickelst Sales-Enablement-Materialien wie Pitch Decks, One-Pager, Product Stories und weitere Assets, die unser Sales-Team im Alltag unterstützen.
Du greifst wiederkehrende Fragen, Einwände und Bedürfnisse unserer Zielgruppen auf und übersetzt sie in wiederverwendbaren Content.
Events & Communications
Du entwickelst Content für Events, Webinare und Konferenzen – von Social Posts und E-Mails bis hin zu Präsentationen, Eventseiten und Materialien vor Ort.
Du unterstützt die Kommunikation vor, während und nach unseren Events und sorgst für einen konsistenten Markenauftritt.
Content Operations
Du baust gemeinsam mit dem deutschen und internationalen Team klare Content-Prozesse und Redaktionspläne auf.
Du koordinierst bei Bedarf Designer, Freelancer, Agenturen und weitere externe Partner.
Du nutzt AI-Tools sinnvoll für Recherche, Drafting, Repurposing und Lokalisierung , ohne dabei Qualität, Genauigkeit und unsere Tonalität aus den Augen zu verlieren.
Du analysierst, welche Themen und Formate funktionieren, und entwickelst unseren Content kontinuierlich weiter.
Dein Profil
Du schreibst und sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und verfügst über sehr gute professionelle Englischkenntnisse.
Du bringst ca. 5 Jahre Erfahrung in Content, Communications, Product Marketing, Brand Content oder B2B Marketing mit.
Du hast Erfahrung darin, für eine B2B-Zielgruppe zu schreiben – idealerweise in SaaS, FinTech, Finance, Accounting oder einem anderen erklärungsbedürftigen bzw. regulierten Umfeld.
Du kannst komplexe Informationen schnell erfassen und daraus klare, relevante und überzeugende Geschichten entwickeln.
Du hast ein sehr gutes redaktionelles Gespür und weißt, was eine Botschaft wirklich braucht – und was man besser weglässt.
Du bist strukturiert und kannst mehrere Themen und Projekte gleichzeitig priorisieren und vorantreiben.
Du fühlst dich wohl dabei, mit unterschiedlichen Teams wie Brand, Product, Sales, Growth und Events zusammenzuarbeiten.
Du brauchst nicht für alles ein perfektes Briefing: Du stellst die richtigen Fragen, schaffst Klarheit und kommst ins Handeln.
Du arbeitest sorgfältig und mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch, ohne dabei Geschwindigkeit und Pragmatismus zu verlieren.

Erfahrung beim Aufbau einer Marke in einem neuen Markt, Kenntnisse im Bereich Content Repurposing und AI-gestützter Content-Prozesse sowie Erfahrung in einem internationalen Umfeld.
Warum diese Rolle besonders ist
Deutschland ist für Pennylane ein strategisch wichtiger Wachstumsmarkt. Gleichzeitig sind wir hier noch eine vergleichsweise junge Marke.
Das bedeutet: Du übernimmst nicht einfach einen bestehenden Content-Kalender, sondern kannst mitgestalten, wie Pennylane in Deutschland spricht, welche Geschichten wir erzählen und wie wir Vertrauen bei Steuerberatungskanzleien und Unternehmen aufbauen.
Du bekommst dafür die Erfahrung, Brand-Grundlagen und Ressourcen unseres internationalen Teams – und gleichzeitig viel Raum, eine Kommunikation zu entwickeln, die sich wirklich nach dem deutschen Markt anfühlt.
Wenn du gerne nah am Markt und am Produkt arbeitest, komplexe Themen verständlich machst und lieber Dinge umsetzt, als sie monatelang in Präsentationen zu diskutieren, könnte diese Rolle sehr gut zu dir passen.

What we do.
Imagine every product on the internet, instantly available to you.
You could take anything from any online shop, resell it, and earn from it . Every influencer could sell the products they already use and love , without ever touching a warehouse. You could spend your Payback points or miles on something you actually want , instead of another forgettable knife set. And your AI could buy any product in the world for you, without your intervention .
We built exactly that. It's live, and it's running today.
Joy_'s AI infrastructure runs the entire e-commerce value chain end to end : sourcing, checkout, payment, fulfillment, customer care, and returns. Across any online shop on the planet. No merchant contracts, no APIs, no closed networks. This is our Universal Purchasing Infrastructure , and it sits right at the center of where AI commerce is going.
On top of it, we build our own business models. The first one live and proven: the gift card .
That's a 20 billion euro market in Germany alone , the single most-gifted thing in the country, and nobody has innovated on it in years. Now there's a gift card you can redeem for any product, from any shop, for any wish .
We've raised from top European funds and angels who've built and scaled some of the most relevant tech and commerce companies around.
Behind it all: a mixed team of twelve, spread across Europe, with a strong center and our office in Berlin.
The technology is done. What we need now is the other half: the narrative, the brand, the story that makes people feel it. That's the job.
Aufgaben

In short: You own the feeling people get in the first 10 seconds. The instant, can't-look-away pull of an Oatly or TrueFruits ad, but for gifting.
This is the rare shot at building a category-defining brand from zero, the kind a whole country ends up recognizing. Everything below serves that.
And to be clear about the shape of the work: you're fluent with data. You read the dashboards and you know exactly what each channel converts. But creation comes first. What we're really hiring for is the instinct to make something loud, something the whole country notices. You build campaigns end to end, from the idea that stops the scroll to the dashboard that proves it worked.
Build the new narrative and positioning. With completely new technology we've lifted the gift card to a whole new level. Your job: tell that story, set us apart from every other gift card, and own the narrative for the new alternative.
Tell the product story. Our card is so good it reads as too good to be true. You make it believable, playing on our "Zu-Gut-Schein" framing, the gift card that's almost too good, and always making clear how it actually works.
Own our two biggest growth channels: TV and Social. This is where we scale. TV and Out of Home put your work in front of millions, on screens and billboards a whole country walks past, and on the retail shelves the card sits on. On Social, you run our own channels plus a TikTok UGC engine that multiplies everything we make.

What you ship isn't a small post for a small feed. When you get it right, a whole country sees it. We start national, but international is already on the map: UK and US are the planned next step, and the brand you build needs to travel.
Hold brand consistency. Narrative and story run through everything we ship, verbally and visually, with no drift. One unmistakable Joy_, everywhere.
Make it convert. In the end, conversion is what counts. You stay fully data-driven, keep the conversion rates per channel in view, and double down on what actually moves them.
Qualifikation
What makes a good fit.
We're not reading your CV for the logos or the degree. We want to see what you've actually built. Show us the creative things you've already pulled off, whether at a past job or on your own time. That's what we're reading for.

s.h: A few traits make it click
s.t:
You've built a brand before, at least 3 years of it. From near zero, or as a core part of the team, ideally in consumer, retail, or culture, for a brand made to reach everyone, not a narrow niche. You know how a campaign works end to end, and you can run the channels that carry it.
You have taste. For brand, for content, for social, for the zeitgeist. You instinctively sense what fits the narrative and what breaks it, verbally, visually, aesthetically, and you know what the internet finds good this week, not last year.
Social media is your daily life, and you've worked with creators and influencers. You know how social actually works from the inside: what makes a collab feel real, what makes it flop, and how to brief people who live on camera.
Bonus: you've run our growth channels yourself. TV and Out of Home, and above all a TikTok UGC engine you built and steered. If you've already stood up your own creator army and made it perform, that's a massive plus.
You're bold in what you ship. In the ideas and concepts you put out, and in the brand language itself. You want to do things in a way nobody has yet.
You make things yourself. You have taste and hands. You can write the script, cut the reel, and build the Notion doc in the same hour.
Insane agency and ownership. You turn chaos into clarity and you'd rather ship rough than wait for permission.
AI-native instincts. You create videos and creative assets with AI without breaking a sweat. The tools change weekly and you don't care, you bend whatever is newest to make more, faster.
Fluency in German and English is a must.

What's in it for you.
🌱 Ownership. The whole brand and marketing surface is yours, working side by side with the founders every day. Real budget for ideas, including 10% of your time for the remarkable stuff (our Blue Slide principle).
🚀 Growth. Work on the frontier of consumer brand-building alongside senior operators and engineers who've built and scaled before.
💡 Autonomy. Remote-first with the freedom to work how you work best.
🎁 Meaningful equity. We want you to win with us.
🛍️ Real impact. See what you build go live across product, campaigns, and shelves. Fast.
Why this role is truly different.
Most brand jobs are about polishing something that already exists, or squeezing a funnel someone else built. This one is a blank canvas, and it's yours to go wild on.
We're young and we want to be loud. The gift card is dusty, an afterthought, the thing people grab when nothing better came to mind, and nobody has touched it in years. We're the fresh, loud opposite, the brand that flips a tired category on its head and ruffles a few feathers doing it. You get the full creative range to live that out, sitting directly with the co-founders with the whole brand surface yours from day one.
Here's why this role outranks everything else in marketing: Joy_ is bought on occasion, not on inspiration. Nobody wakes up wanting a gift card. People buy when a birthday or a thank-you lands on them, and they reach for whatever name is already in their head. So we have to get there first. That makes brand awareness our single most important channel and our biggest priority , and it comes with real budget .

Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.
At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.
This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Lead Product Marketing Manager to join our core Marketing team at Lumen. This role involves executing product marketing strategies and supporting the overall product marketing efforts. You will work closely with the Director of Product Marketing, relevant product leaders, and other cross-functional teams to ensure the successful delivery of our Lumen digital products.

Contribute to Lumen Connectivity products: Develop content, collateral and other marketing materials to support product launches and sales efforts for Lumen Connectivity in support of Lumen digital products.
Develop Content: Create and update content for external websites, including product pages and customer success stories.
Collaborate with Cross-Functional Teams: Work closely with other product marketers in support of the Lumen digital portfolio, as well as product, IT, and customer service departments to support product and solution strategy and execution.
Conduct Market Research: Assist in competitive analysis and market research to identify trends, opportunities, and threats.
Support Marketing Campaigns: Assist in messaging development and execution for marketing campaigns and customer incentive programs to grow sales and revenue for Lumen connectivity digital products and solutions
Maintain Stakeholder Relationships: Support the gathering of insights from key stakeholders, including customers and partners, to inform product strategy.
What We Look For in a Candidate
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field.
3-5 years of experience in Product Marketing or a related field.
Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and projects simultaneously.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to analyze market trends and data to support marketing strategies.

Bei Simplifier möchten wir Kandidaten:innen die Möglichkeit bieten, in einem spannenden und sich schnell wandelnden Umfeld mitzuwirken und dabei mit Experten:innen für die Digitalisierung von morgen zusammenzuarbeiten. All dies in einer wertschätzenden und inspirierenden Arbeitsatmosphäre, für ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt und die Möglichkeit, von überall aus zu arbeiten.
Du willst wissen, ob Deine Erwartungen und unsere Rollenanforderung ein Match sind? Dann lies einfach weiter:
Dein Value: Du hast bereits erste Berufserfahrung im Digital Marketing gesammelt und möchtest jetzt den nächsten Schritt machen. Du denkst nicht nur in einzelnen Kanälen, sondern hast Lust zu verstehen, wie Paid, Organic, Search, Content, Marketing Automation und AI zusammenspielen, um messbare Ergebnisse zu erzielen.
Dabei musst du noch lange nicht alles können. Uns ist wichtiger, dass du neugierig bist, gerne ausprobierst, aus Daten lernst und Verantwortung für deine Themen übernehmen möchtest.
Dein Purpose: Gemeinsam mit unserem Marketing-Team entwickelst und realisierst du digitale Kampagnen entlang unserer B2B Customer Journey – von Awareness und Traffic über Conversion bis hin zu Lead Nurturing.
Deine Vorteile bei uns: Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag, FlexWork mit 100% Remote bis 100% Office, Erfolgsbeteiligung, E-Bike-Leasing sowie Vertrauensarbeitszeiten und betriebliche Altersvorsorge sind bei uns nichts Außergewöhnliches. Vielmehr hast Du die Möglichkeit bei der Simplifier AG einen richtig großartigen Teamspirit zu erleben.
Aufgaben

Digital Campaigns & Paid : Du bist für Planung, Umsetzung und Optimierung digitaler B2B-Kampagnen verantwortlich, insbesondere über LinkedIn. Du entwickelst Landingpages weiter und behältst User Journey und Conversion im Blick.
Marketing Automation & Nurturing : Du nutzt HubSpot (oder ein anderes Automation Tool) für Kampagnenentwicklung, E-Mail-Strecken und automatisierte Prozesse. Du sorgst dafür, dass Interessenten relevante Inhalte erhalten.
SEO, GEO & Organic : Du unterstützt bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer SEO-Strategie und übernimmst Teilbereiche der Optimierung unserer digitalen Inhalte. Du beschäftigst dich mit GEO / AI Search und unseren organischen Präsenzen auf LinkedIn.
AI in Marketing : AI ist Teil deiner täglichen Arbeit. Du experimentierst damit im Bereich Marketing, um Prozesse effizienter zu gestalten und identifizierst neue AI Use Cases.
Qualifikation

Du hast erste praktische Berufserfahrung im Digital Marketing.
Du hast idealerweise bereits im B2B-Umfeld gearbeitet.
Du hast erste praktische Erfahrung mit Paid Social, idealerweise LinkedIn Ads.
Du kennst die Grundlagen von SEO und interessierst dich für neue Entwicklungen rund um GEO und AI Search.
Du hast bereits mit Marketing Automation oder CRM-Systemen gearbeitet – idealerweise HubSpot.
Du hast ein grundlegendes Verständnis für E-Mail-Marketing, Lead Generation und Nurturing.
Du kannst Marketing nicht nur kreativ, sondern auch datengetrieben betrachten und kennst relevante KPIs wie CTR, Conversion Rate oder CPL.
Du sprichst und schreibst sehr gutes Deutsch und kannst dich auch auf Englisch sicher bewegen.

s.h: Nice to have – aber kein Muss
s.t:
Besonders freuen wir uns, wenn du bereits Erfahrungen aus einem Software-, SaaS- oder IT-Unternehmen mitbringst oder schon einmal mit HubSpot, LinkedIn Campaign Manager oder AI-basierten Marketing-Workflows gearbeitet hast.
Aber: Du musst nicht bei jedem Punkt einen Haken setzen können.
Wenn du digitale Kampagnen verstehst, neugierig auf B2B-Tech bist und Lust hast, dich fachlich gemeinsam mit uns weiterzuentwickeln, möchten wir dich kennenlernen.

Du arbeitest eigenständig, strukturiert und hands-on.
Du hast Spaß daran, Dinge zu testen, Ergebnisse auszuwerten und kontinuierlich besser zu machen.
Du interessierst dich für Technologie und kannst dich auch in erklärungsbedürftige B2B-Themen schnell einarbeiten.

What to expect Are you an organizational talent with initial experience in HR and/or marketing, eager to help shape the intersection of people, marketing, and business development in an HR boutique? Are you tech-savvy, work quickly and precisely, and have a good eye for aesthetics, clear communication, and polished results?
Then you’re a fit for us. We’re not looking for a pure assistant who simply ticks off tasks, but an independent, versatile person who will further develop our external presence, support projects operationally, and relieve the team in day-to-day business—with high velocity, a strong quality mindset, and a genuine drive to contribute.
Your tasks and responsibilities Marketing & Communication You independently own our marketing channels: LinkedIn, newsletter, website, and online events—from concept and planning through content creation to operational execution
You create content for our B2B social media channels—professional, on-brand, and tailored to the target audience
You keep our website up to date, maintain content, optimize layout and formatting, and ensure a consistent, aesthetic appearance
You plan and organize online events, webinars, and partner events and support their operational delivery
You manage communication and coordination with our partners and external service providers
HR & Project Support
You support our consulting team on client projects: data analysis, data preparation, research, presentations, and documentation
You contribute to HR software implementations—e.g., data migration, test runs, configuration, and quality assurance
You support recruiting: candidate sourcing, applicant communication, scheduling, and ATS maintenance
You create professional project materials, reports, proposals, and presentations in PowerPoint, Google Slides, and other tools
You take on organizational and administrative tasks that relieve the team in day-to-day operations
Your profile
2+ years of professional experience in HR, marketing, project management, or a comparable coordinating role—ideally in a start-up, consulting environment, or agency
University degree or completed vocational training in a relevant field
Highly tech-savvy: you quickly get up to speed with new tools, platforms, and systems and enjoy optimizing digital processes
You work at very high speed, have a quick grasp of new topics, and bring strong organizational talent and project management skills
You have a good eye for aesthetics, design, formatting, and spelling—your outputs look professional and are error-free
Advanced skills in MS Office (especially Excel and PowerPoint) and Google Workspace; you create visually appealing presentations and documents
You understand B2B social media and know how to create professional LinkedIn content that drives reach and relevance
Experience with content management systems, newsletter tools (e.g., Mailchimp, HubSpot), or comparable platforms
You work independently, reliably, and in a structured way—even when managing multiple tasks in parallel
Fluent written and spoken German and English; additional languages are a plus
Based in Switzerland with the appropriate residence and work permits

Remote only: Work from wherever you’re most productive—on-site at the client only in exceptional cases; team events approx. once per quarter
Maximum flexibility: Part-time from 40% (16 hours/week) possible—you set your own working hours
Responsibility from day one: You are a core part of our team—no hierarchy, short decision paths
Variety: No two days are alike—you work at the intersection of marketing, HR, and project business and get to know the full spectrum of an HR boutique
Appreciation: We value you as a team member and as a person—trust, coaching, and honest feedback are part of our culture
